help.shortcut.quickOpen: Open a file in the area by typing part of its name
help.shortcut.newSubpage: Create a new subpage of the active page
help.shortcut.detachSubpage: Detach the active subpage from its parent page
help.shortcut.rejoinParts: Turn a split document back into a single file
help.shortcut.moveTab: Move active tab to the other column
help.shortcut.searchNavEnter: Next / previous match (in the search bar)
help.shortcut.newApp: Start a new application (separate window group)
help.shortcut.openArea: Open a folder area as the application's working space
help.shortcut.closeArea: Close the area (closes all windows of the area application)
help.shortcut.createDemoArea: Copy the bundled Demo-Area into an empty folder and open it as an area
help.shortcut.openBook: Open a book (folder with book file and companion file)
help.shortcut.newBook: Create a new book (folder, book file and companion file)
help.shortcut.closeBook: Close the active book (open tabs stay open)
help.shortcut.openShelf: Open a bookshelf (folder with shelf file and companion file)
help.shortcut.newShelf: Create a new bookshelf (folder, shelf file and companion file)
help.shortcut.closeShelf: Close the active bookshelf (open tabs stay open)
help.shortcut.nextChapter: Open the next chapter of the book (reading order of the table of contents)
help.shortcut.previousChapter: Open the previous chapter of the book (reading order of the table of contents)
help.shortcut.moveChapterFile: Move a chapter file to another folder of the book; links and chapter tree follow
help.shortcut.workspaceSaveAs: Save the current application as a workspace
help.shortcut.workspaceClose: Close the workspace (its state remains stored)
help.shortcut.exportPdf: Export the active tab as PDF
help.shortcut.exportPortable: Export the active tab as portable Markdown
help.shortcut.toggleScrollSync: Turn scroll synchronisation of the split view on or off
help.shortcut.toggleTypewriterScroll: Turn typewriter scroll on or off
help.shortcut.toggleRestoreSession: Turn session restore on startup on or off
help.shortcut.replaceAll: Replace all (in the replace field of the search bar)
help.shortcut.toggleOutline: Show/hide table-of-contents sidebar in the active column
help.shortcut.toggleOutgoingLinks: Show/hide outgoing-links sidebar in the active column
help.shortcut.toggleBacklinks: Show/hide backlinks sidebar in the active column
help.shortcut.toggleBookmarks: Show/hide bookmarks sidebar in the active column
help.shortcut.toggleProperties: Show/hide properties sidebar in the active column
help.shortcut.toggleSearchResults: Show or hide the search results panel
help.shortcut.toggleTags: Show/hide tags sidebar in the active column
help.shortcut.toggleFoldGutter: Show/hide folding gutter in the source view
help.shortcut.toggleLineNumbers: Show/hide line numbers in the source view
help.shortcut.toggleWordWrap: Show/hide word wrap in the source view
help.shortcut.foldRegion: Fold heading or block region at cursor
help.shortcut.zoom: Zoom in, zoom out, reset to 100 %
help.shortcut.tabIndent: Indent or outdent list item; in pipe tables: next / previous cell
help.shortcut.insertCalendarValue: Opens the picker for custom calendars and inserts the chosen point in time as a calendar value at the cursor.
help.shortcut.openHistory: Open the document history of the active document
help.shortcut.areaGraph: Open the area graph as its own tab
help.shortcut.areaStats: Open the area statistics as its own tab
help.shortcut.myExtendedMemory: Open My Extended Memory as its own tab
help.shortcut.toggleReminders: Show or hide the reminders panel
help.shortcut.toggleAreaPanel: Show or hide the area panel
help.shortcut.toggleBookPanel: Show or hide the book panel
help.shortcut.toggleCalendarPanel: Show or hide the calendar panel
help.shortcut.toggleSidebarLeft: Collapse or expand the left sidebar column
help.shortcut.toggleSidebarRight: Collapse or expand the right sidebar column
help.shortcut.taskSetReminder: Set or change the reminder marker on the task line
help.shortcut.saveSidebarVariant: Saves the current sidebar arrangement including panel visibility as a named variant.
help.shortcut.applySidebarVariant: Opens the variant picker and applies the chosen sidebar arrangement.
help.shortcut.insertTimestamp: Insert the current timestamp at the cursor position (in edit mode)
help.shortcut.insertDateTime: Open the date/time picker and insert date plus time at the cursor position (in edit mode)
help.shortcut.insertDate: Open the date picker and insert only the date at the cursor position (in edit mode)
help.shortcut.insertTime: Open the time picker and insert only the time at the cursor position (in edit mode)
help.shortcut.newFromTemplate: Create a new file from a template (picker popup, placeholders are filled in)
help.shortcut.journalToday: Open or create today's journal entry (with a picker if several daily journals exist)
help.shortcut.journalNachtragen: Add the missing journal properties to all entries of a journal
help.shortcut.journalForDate: Open or create the journal entry for a chosen date
help.shortcut.insertTemplate: Insert a template at the cursor position (in edit mode)
help.shortcutsConfigurableNote: The table shows the currently configured shortcuts. They can be changed in the settings (File → Settings).
help.shortcut.paragraphBulletList: Toggle lines as a bulleted list
help.shortcut.paragraphOrderedList: Toggle lines as a numbered list
help.shortcut.paragraphTaskList: Toggle lines as a task list
help.shortcut.listMove: Move a list item with its sub-items up or down; outside lists, the single line
help.shortcut.listSelectSubtree: Select a list item together with all its sub-items
help.shortcut.tableColInsert: Insert table column to the right
help.shortcut.tableTranspose: Transpose the table (swap rows and columns)
help.shortcut.taskEditDialog: Opens the task dialog: edits the task line under the cursor or creates a new task on an empty line.
help.shortcut.insertEvents: Inserts an empty event block at the cursor position.
help.shortcut.openFieldForm: Shows every field of the document at once, with profile and inheritance level per field.
help.shortcut.insertProfileQuery: Generates the query for a profile's documents and inserts it at the cursor position. It covers the assignment field as well as the profile's tag and folder bindings; if the profile is the area's default profile, the query covers all documents. The inserted block is ordinary content and can be edited afterwards.
help.shortcut.exportSetup: Export your own settings to a file
help.shortcut.importSetup: Import your own settings from a file
help.shortcut.exportLocaleTemplate: Save a template for your own interface language as a file
help.shortcut.importLocale: Load a translated language file as your own interface language
help.shortcut.removeLocale: Remove one of your own interface languages from the application
help.shortcut.updateLocale: Save your own language file at the state of the running program version, missing entries in English
